title: Practice 23: On Wednesday, in that minute, the next day: в and на + accusative

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: На ___ (третий день) — то же самое.
exercises.why: «The preposition НА + Acc. is used: (a) to indicate the length of time one expects to stay some place, or the time something is expected to last; (b) after the verb опаздывать / опоздать to indicate the amount of time by which someone is late.» «Note also such expressions as: на следующий день — (next day).» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 73.  ·  *Антон Чехов, «Скверная история»*
exercises.context: НА + Accusative indicates how long something is expected to last. (DLI, Lesson 73)
